prompt_head:
Role: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
[r1] (required, other) Professional experience building and deploying prod

assessments.note: Built and shipped production AI software and platforms.
Proficient in Python and TypeScript, used in projects.
Designed and implemented multi-stage agent pipelines.
Familiar with orchestrator and pipeline methodologies.
Used backtesting and prompts for AI evaluation.
Understands prompt trade‑offs and context management.
Implemented data validation and tool‑calling agents.
Experienced with APIs, cloud workers, and modern dev practices.
Rapidly adapts to new domains and technologies.
Prototyped, validated, and deployed production AI systems.
Balances model performance with product constraints.
Communicates AI system behavior and trade‑offs clearly.
Located in South Florida, near required area.
Collaborated with clients and internal teams on deliveries.

output.verdict_line: The candidate meets most technical and soft requirements but lacks demonstrated willingness to travel.
top_gaps: Ability to travel occasionally for client workshops
Familiarity with graph‑based orchestration and state machines
